title: DocFS: File Systems as Agentic Reasoning Environments for Complex Multimodal Document Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.12957v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: VLM-based agents solve complex tasks by iteratively interacting with environments, and their effectiveness depends heavily on how the environment exposes information and provides tools for acting on it. However, constructing an effective environment for complex multimodal document question answering remains challenging: documents usually span many pages, with multimodal contents distributed across hierarchical sections and linked by cross-modal associations, while existing methods organize documents into structured representations that address only the information side of the environment and lack tools aligned with the structure, limiting agents' ability to fully exploit it. We observe that file systems naturally combine structure organization with aligned tools: directories and files encode document structure, while file operations provide rich tools to access file contents. Building on this insight, we propose DocFS, a file-system-base

translated_title: DocFS：文件系统作为复杂多模态文档问答的智能体推理环境
translated_abstract: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体通过与环境的迭代交互来解决复杂任务，其有效性在很大程度上取决于环境如何暴露信息并提供作用于信息的工具。然而，为复杂的多模态文档问答构建有效的环境仍然具有挑战性：文档通常跨越多页，多模态内容分布在层级章节中，并通过跨模态关联相互链接，而现有方法将文档组织成结构化表示，仅解决了环境的信息层面，缺乏与结构对齐的工具，限制了智能体充分利用文档结构的能力。我们观察到，文件系统天然地将结构化组织与对齐的工具结合在一起：目录和文件编码文档结构，而文件操作提供了丰富的工具来访问文件内容。基于这一洞察，我们提出了DocFS，一个基于文件系统的智能体推理环境，用于复杂多模态文档问答。
tldr: 该论文提出DocFS，将文件系统作为智能体推理环境，利用目录与文件的层级结构编码多模态文档的组织结构，并借助文件操作工具访问内容，从而提升智能体在复杂多模态文档问答中的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DocFS, which leverages file systems as agentic reasoning environments, encoding hierarchical multimodal document structures into directories and files while aligning file operation tools to access content, thereby improving agent performance on complex multimodal document question answering.
